free_tier.stated: 2.5 GB per file; 1 TB per Dataverse Collection for non-Harvard researchers (2.5 TB for Harvard affiliates). The 1 TB is real and stated by Harvard, but it is a *service/support* threshold, not a hard enforced cap — see limits.

egress.terms: Free and unmetered. Public file access returns 303 -> a presigned S3 URL (dvn-cloud-iqss.s3.amazonaws.com) valid 3600s; S3 honours Range requests. No egress pricing exists anywhere in the product. Probe: GET /api/access/datafile/11685194 -L -H 'Range: bytes=0-1023' -> 303 then HTTP 206, Content-Range: bytes 0-1023/21269528, Server: AmazonS3.

tooling: Native REST API v6.10.1 (live: GET /api/info/version -> {"version":"6.10.1"}); SWORD v2 deposit; OAI-PMH harvest; S3 direct-upload API for files >2.5 GB (docs: 'This option can handle files >300GB'). Python client pyDataverse; R package dataverse. No rclone backend, but a REST loop is trivial (~15 lines) and the platform is a well-documented Invenio-free Java stack.
chaining: Unlimited Dataverse Collections per account (Harvard: 9,755 collections / 306,011 datasets exist, anyone may create one). x 1 TB per collection. 20 collections = 20 TB in one account; 20 accounts = 400 TB. Also multiplies per *dataset* rather than per collection if the 1 TB is read as a guidance number, since no per-dataset quota is enforced on the root collection.

limits_note: Per-file 2.5 GB through the Harvard UI/API; larger files require the S3 direct-upload path, which Harvard has enabled (downloads already redirect to S3, so upload-redirect is configured). Dataset file-count cap observed live: effectiveDatasetFileCountLimit=1000 (12 used on the sampled dataset). No enforced collection quota: GET /api/dataverses/harvard/storage/quota?showInherited=true -> {"message":"No quota defined for this collection"}. Publishing is a 'Submit for Review' spam-check gate, not peer review.
reliability_note: Mature, 15+ year old service with DOI permanence and S3-backed bytes; the only soft failure mode is a curator rejecting a deposit at the review gate, and the storage-quota feature is flagged 'new and still experimental' upstream.
confidence_note: The quota endpoint answers were re-read. The record keeps `reported` because the per-file cap and the identity field were not measured. Was reported; now documented.
